blocks.text: Volumetric analysis mein solutions ki concentration (har volume mein kitni cheez) titration naam ke tareeqe se maloom ki jati hai. Is mein unknown (anjaan) concentration wala solution, standard solution (jis ki concentration maloom ho) ke known volume ke saath aahista aahista milaya jata hai, jab tak rang ka change yeh na bata de ke reaction complete ho gaya.

blocks.title: Indicator
blocks.text: Woh substance jo apna rang badal kar batata hai ke reaction complete ho gaya, indicator kehlata hai.

blocks.title: End point
blocks.text: Jis moment (pal) par indicator apna rang badalta hai, use end point kehte hain.
Dono mein se koi bhi solution burette mein liya ja sakta hai aur doosra conical flask (titration flask) mein.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Phenolphthalein solution banane ke liye 1 gram indicator ko 500 cm³ 50% ethanol mein dalte hain. Titrate hone wale 10 cm³ solution mein sirf ek ya do qatre dalein. pH kam hone par is ka rang gulabi se be-rang hota hai. End point wala halka gulabi rang hawa ki carbon dioxide ke dheere dheere solution mein ghulne ki wajah se aahista aahista phika par jata hai.
